annotations.title: Count PubMed papers that mention a behavioral test

description: Returns ConductScience's counts of the animal research papers in PubMed that mention one behavioral test, such as the Morris water maze or the forced swim test, in their title or abstract. The counts cover the last five full years. They include the test on any maker's apparatus, not only ConductScience's. It gives how many papers mention the test, how many of those study mice and how many study rats, the tests most often mentioned with it and the health conditions those papers study most. It also links ConductScience's page for the test, which shows how the papers are counted, and lists ConductScience products for the test. Use it when someone asks how often published research mentions a behavioral test. If the name matches none of the tests ConductScience counts, it returns no counts and links the list of tests it does count.

test.description: A behavioral test's name, abbreviation or apparatus, such as "Morris water maze", "EPM" or "shuttle box"

name: get_test_data

other_matches.description: Other tests ConductScience counts that the name also matches

products.description: ConductScience products for the test, each with its page

products_total.description: How many products ConductScience lists for the test, or null when its store could not be checked

products_url.description: The store page that lists them all, or null when there are none

conditions_studied.description: The health conditions those papers study most, each with how many papers study it. A paper can count under several

data_url.description: ConductScience's page for the test, with its papers per year and how they are counted, or null when there is none

papers.description: How many animal research papers in PubMed mention the test in their title or abstract from first_year to last_year, on any maker's apparatus

papers_naming_mice.description: How many of those papers study mice. A paper can study mice and rats, or neither

papers_naming_rats.description: How many of those papers study rats

released.description: The day ConductScience released the counts, as YYYY-MM-DD

tests_alongside.description: The tests those papers most often mention with this one, each with how many papers mention both

test.description: The counts for the test the name matches, or null when it matches none ConductScience counts

title: Count PubMed papers that mention a behavioral test
